rows.label: tlk45310341_03_msg0001
rows.name:
You're starting to get the look of
a veteran mercenary about you.

rows.label: tlk45310341_03_msg0003
rows.name:
But you're leading the Hræsvelgr
Mercenaries splendidly, just like
Vandham-san did.

rows.label: tlk45310341_03_msg0004
rows.name:
As the mercenary group grows, the
number of Blades we can deploy grows
too.

rows.label: tlk45310341_03_msg0005
rows.name:
You can only bring three Blades
per Driver at once, but it's good
to have plenty in reserve!

rows.label: tlk45310341_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Let's aim to make this mercenary
group even bigger.
